## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For documentation changes, confirm the
updated commands and links. For behaviour changes, include a focused regression
test.

## Compatibility and research impact

Note any schema, scenario, adapter or benchmark changes. Explain whether an
existing protocol or result interpretation is affected.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change contains no credentials, personal data or raw production traces.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implementation and its limits.
- [ ] Generated files or versioned contracts are updated where required.
